question: How do I get a criminal record expunged or sealed?

nuggets.text: The petition is filed in the circuit court of the county or city where the case was heard.
nuggets.quote: The petition with a copy of the warrant, summons, or indictment if reasonably available shall be filed in the circuit court of the county or city in which the case was disposed of by acquittal or being otherwise dismissed and shall contain, except when not reasonably available, the date of arrest and the name of the arresting agency.

nuggets.text: A person acquitted, or whose charge was dismissed or nolle prossed, may petition.
nuggets.quote: A nolle prosequi is taken or the charge is otherwise dismissed, including dismissal by accord and satisfaction pursuant to § 19.2-151 , he may file a petition setting forth the relevant facts and requesting expungement of the police records and the court records relating to the charge.

nuggets.text: The petitioner is fingerprinted and the Central Criminal Records Exchange reports to the court.
nuggets.quote: A petition filed under this subsection shall include one complete set of the petitioner's fingerprints obtained from a law-enforcement agency.

nuggets.text: The petition is accompanied by the warrant or indictment.
nuggets.quote: The petition with a copy of the warrant, summons, or indictment if reasonably available shall be filed in the circuit court of the county or city in which the case was disposed of by acquittal or being otherwise dismissed and shall contain, except when not reasonably available, the date of arrest and the name of the arresting agency.

nuggets.text: Either party may appeal the order.
nuggets.quote: Any party aggrieved by the decision of the court may appeal, as provided by law in civil cases.
